spec: Write slug.py with `slugify(text: str, max_len: int = 50) -> str`. Lowercase; transliterate accented Latin letters to ASCII (use unicodedata NFKD and drop combining marks); every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 becomes a single '-'; strip leading/trailing '-'; truncate to max_len without leaving a trailing '-'. Empty result returns ''. Standard library only.
